# PicoSite — Zero-Config Static Site Generator

> Write Markdown, run two commands, get a website.

PicoSite is a lightweight, zero-configuration static site generator built with .NET 10. It compiles to a single ~10MB AOT binary with no runtime dependencies. Unlike Node.js-based SSGs that are bloated and slow, or Go/Rust alternatives that follow rigid "config-driven + theme" patterns, PicoSite aims to be simple, no burden, and just works.

## Quick Start

1. Put `picosite` binary in your Markdown folder
2. Run `picosite serve` and open http://localhost:8090 to preview
3. Edit Markdown — browser auto-reloads
4. Run `picosite build` to generate static files to `_site/`

## Commands

- `picosite serve` — Start dev server with hot reload
- `picosite build` — Generate static files to `_site/`

### Options

| Option | Applies to | Default |
|--------|-----------|---------|
| `--port 3000` | serve | 8090 |
| `--theme dark` | serve, build | default |
| `--theme-dir ./Themes/default` | serve, build | Themes/ directory next to exe |
| `--output ./dist` | build | ./_site |
| `--baseUrl /PicoSite/` | build | baseUrl from picosite.json |

## Writing Content

Place Markdown files under `content/`. File path = URL:

```
content/index.md      → /
content/about.md      → /about
content/blog/post.md  → /blog/post
```

Add YAML Front Matter at the top:

```markdown
---
title: My Article
date: 2026-06-09
---
```

## Key Features

- **Zero Configuration** — No config file needed. Just run it.
- **Hot Reload** — Live preview while editing Markdown.
- **Multi-language** — ISO language subdirectories auto-detected.
- **Liquid Templates** — Fluid.Core-based theme system with full customization.
- **Dark Mode** — Built-in theme switcher with localStorage persistence.
- **SEO Ready** — Auto-generates sitemap.xml and robots.txt on build.
- **Math & Diagrams** — KaTeX and Mermaid.js support built-in.
- **Code Highlighting** — highlight.js with dark theme.
- **AOT Compiled** — Single ~10MB binary, no .NET runtime needed.

## Project Structure

```
PicoSite/
├── Commands/           # CLI command implementations
│   ├── BuildCommand.cs     # `picosite build` handler
│   ├── ServeCommand.cs     # `picosite serve` handler
│   └── GetVersionCommand.cs
├── Models/             # Data models
│   ├── SiteConfig.cs       # Configuration model
│   ├── SiteModel.cs        # Site data model passed to templates
│   ├── PageModel.cs        # Single page metadata
│   ├── NavNode.cs          # Navigation tree node
│   └── ChineseLocalization.cs
├── Services/           # Core business logic
│   ├── ConfigLoader.cs     # Loads picosite.json config
│   ├── MarkdownParser.cs   # Parses .md + YAML front matter → HTML
│   ├── SiteGenerator.cs    # Builds static site, generates sitemap/robots
│   ├── TemplateEngine.cs   # Liquid template rendering
│   ├── HotReloadService.cs # File watcher for dev server
│   └── PicoSiteJsonContext.cs  # Native AOT JSON source generator
├── Themes/default/     # Default theme (Liquid templates)
│   ├── index.html          # Home page template
│   ├── page.html           # Article page template
│   ├── header.html         # Navbar + search
│   ├── footer.html         # Footer
│   ├── sidebar.html        # Sidebar menu
│   ├── 404.html            # 404 error page
│   ├── vendor-loader.html  # 3rd-party JS/CSS loader
│   └── assets/style.css    # Theme styles (light/dark)
├── PicoSite.csproj     # Project file (targets net10.0, AOT)
└── Program.cs          # Entry point, CLI root command
```

## Configuration (picosite.json)

```json
{
  "title": "My Site",
  "baseUrl": "/",
  "theme": "default"
}
```

Per-language overrides via `content/zh/site.json`, `content/en/site.json`, etc.

## Technical Stack

- **Runtime:** .NET 10 (Native AOT)
- **Markdown:** Markdig 0.40
- **Templates:** Fluid.Core 2.31 (Liquid)
- **CLI:** System.CommandLine
- **Dev Server:** PicoServer 1.7 (embedded HTTP server with hot reload)
- **Frontend:** KaTeX, Mermaid.js, highlight.js
